items.title: Isaiah Morgan Interview, 1958-12-01
items.q: No, Dave Perkins used to work at Royal Iron. I didn't know that.

ctx.x: Trombone, was it Perkins, what's his name, you know, the real light fella? Dave Perkins. Dave Perkins. Would it be him?
No, Dave Perkins used to work at Royal Iron. I didn't know that.
